sections.name: clear sky
sections.desc:
Calculate based on clear sky radiation: a * Si / Si0 + 1 - a where Si is global
radiation and Si0 is clear sky radiation.
sections.sig:
< clear sky (cloudiness cloudiness )
                   (a a )
                   (min extraterrestrial radiation 0 [W/m2 ])
                   (min global radiation 0 [W/m2 ])
                   (min solar elevation angle 0.174533 [rad])
                   (min radiation ratio 0.3 [<fraction>])
                   (min time to sunset 0 [h])
                   (min time from sunrise min time from sunrise ) >

attrs.name: min extraterrestrial radiation
attrs.doc:
Only calculate cloudiness when extraterrestrial radiation is above this. Oth-
     erwise, last value will be used.

attrs.name: min global radiation
attrs.doc:
Only calculate cloudiness when global radiation is above this. Otherwise, last
     value will be used.

attrs.name: min solar elevation angle
attrs.doc:
Value description: FAO56 suggest 2-3 hour before sunset, ASCE suggest 20
     dg solar angle. See also [Allen et al., 2005]
     Only calculate cloudiness when solar elevation angle is above this. Otherwise,
     last value will be used.

attrs.name: min radiation ratio
attrs.doc: Lowest Si/Si0 ration for calculating cloudiness.

attrs.name: min time to sunset
attrs.doc: Don’t calculate cloudiness after this time before sunset.

attrs.name: min time from sunrise
attrs.doc:
Don’t calculate cloudiness less than this time after sunrise. By default, equal
        to ’min time to sunset’.

attrs.name: clear sky radiation
attrs.doc: Global radiation with clear sky conditions.

sections.text:
Calculate based on clear sky radiation: a * Si / Si0 + 1 - a where Si is global
radiation and Si0 is clear sky radiation.
  < clear sky (cloudiness cloudiness )
                   (a a )
                   (min extraterrestrial radiation 0 [W/m2 ])
                   (min global radiation 0 [W/m2 ])
                   (min solar elevation angle 0.174533 [rad])
                   (min radiation ratio 0.3 [<fraction>])
                   (min time to sunset 0 [h])
                   (min time from sunrise min time from sunrise ) >

    cloudiness: number [<fraction>]
     Optional state variable
     Cloudiness.

    a: number (dimensionless)
     Parameter
     Cloudiness coefficient.

    min extraterrestrial radiation: number [W/m2 ]
     Parameter (default 0)
     Only calculate cloudiness when extraterrestrial radiation is above this. Oth-
     erwise, last value will be used.

    min global radiation: number [W/m2 ]
     Parameter (default 0)
     Only calculate cloudiness when global radiation is above this. Otherwise, last
     value will be used.

    min solar elevation angle: number [rad]
     Parameter (default 0.174533)
     Value description: FAO56 suggest 2-3 hour before sunset, ASCE suggest 20
     dg solar angle. See also [Allen et al., 2005]
     Only calculate cloudiness when solar elevation angle is above this. Otherwise,
     last value will be used.

       min radiation ratio: number [<fraction>]
        Parameter (default 0.3)
        Lowest Si/Si0 ration for calculating cloudiness.

       min time to sunset: number [h]
        Parameter (default 0)
        Don’t calculate cloudiness after this time before sunset.

       min time from sunrise: number [h]
        Optional parameter
        Don’t calculate cloudiness less than this time after sunrise. By default, equal
        to ’min time to sunset’.

Log Variables
       clear sky radiation: number [W/m2 ]
        Global radiation with clear sky conditions.

sections.name: ASCE
sections.desc:
A ‘clear sky’ model (see 25.1, page 149) build into Daisy.
   Equation D.1 in the ASCE std ref evap report. See also [Allen et al., 2005]
sections.sig:
< ASCE (Kt 1 [<fraction>])
              ;; Shared parameters are described in section 25.1.
              (cloudiness cloudiness )
              (a a )
              (min extraterrestrial radiation 0 [W/m2 ])
              (min global radiation 0 [W/m2 ])
              (min solar elevation angle 0.174533 [rad])
              (min radiation ratio 0.3 [<fraction>])
              (min time to sunset 0 [h])
              (min time from sunrise min time from sunrise ) >

attrs.name: Kt
attrs.doc: Turbidity coefficient, 1 = clean air, <= 0.5 extremely unclean.

sections.text:

              (cloudiness cloudiness )
              (a a )

sections.name: Taastrup
sections.desc:
A ‘ASCE’ model (see 25.2, page 150) build into Daisy.
   ASCE calibrated for Taastrup, Denmark. See also [Kjaersgaard et al., 2007a]
sections.text:
A ‘ASCE’ model (see 25.2, page 150) build into Daisy.
   ASCE calibrated for Taastrup, Denmark. See also [Kjaersgaard et al., 2007a]
   Used by bioclimate default cloudiness (see 19.2, page 115) .
  < (a 1 [])
      (min extraterrestrial radiation 25 [W/m2 ])
      (min solar elevation angle 0 [rad]) >

sections.name: FAO56
sections.desc:
A ‘clear sky’ model (see 25.1, page 149) build into Daisy.
   Function of station height, Eq 37, FAO56. See also [Allen et al., 1998]
sections.used: bioclimate FAO56 daily cloudiness (see 19.3, page 115) , and bioclimate FAO56 hourly cloudiness (see 19.4, page 116) .
